name: hero
facts: Transcripts are enumerated from ~/.claude/projects and filtered to the window, excluding the session running the pass
Triage scores every in-window session from cheap metadata before any extractor agent runs
Extraction returns signals in four families: friction and failure, repetition and missed automation, wins and effective patterns, environment gaps
Signals are merged and deduped into cross-session clusters before any verdict is decided
A new-skill verdict needs at least 3 distinct sessions; automation and fix need at least 2
